answer: Each claim must arrive as a pearl: layers of stranger-verified work, one layer per epoch, each fused by that epoch's quartz beacon pulse, unpredictable, key-bound. A pearl counts only if its layers are distinct jobs from distinct strangers. An island harbor admits one pearl per funding trail per epoch through a single gate; extra pearls queue behind it and the gate toll doubles per queued pearl. A fleet of n clones must grow n pearls with n times the real stranger work, pay doubling tolls, yet share one harbor slot and one payout, so fleet cost outruns n while revenue caps at one pearl.
